item.title: Renormalisation Group IV: Fixed Points and Universality
item.description: Part 4 of the renormalisation group course. What a critical point looks like, why it is a fixed point of the RG, relevant and irrelevant directions as a ball on a mountain ridge, critical exponents from one number, universality as a river basin and the exact 2D critical temperature from a mirror symmetry. With a live 2D Ising simulation you can coarse-grain.

item.title: Renormalisation Group VI: The Wilson-Fisher Fixed Point
item.description: Part 6 of the renormalisation group course. The one-loop momentum-shell RG of phi^4 theory, step by step, the flow equations read as a population with limited food, the Wilson-Fisher fixed point in d = 4 - epsilon and critical exponents compared with experiment. With an interactive flow diagram.
